assumptions.claim: Immutables quoteToken, vrfWrapper, and raffleImplementation hold their canonical non-zero protocol addresses when read for destination screening at L158-L166.
isRaffle contains all previously registered clones of this factory and cannot be mutated during the external STATICCALL at L172.
assumptions.establishedBy: RaffleFactory.createRaffle nonReentrant guard and registration (packages/contracts/src/RaffleFactory.sol:L97, L125) and _validateCreateParams view visibility (L154)

assumptions.claim: params.sponsorRecipient is also screened against the newly deployed raffle clone address (which is not yet in isRaffle when _validateCreateParams runs at L98) and protocolTreasury is screened against params.prizeToken.

params.prizeToken having code.length > 0 (L155, L184) and returning true from IERC165.supportsInterface(type(IERC721).interfaceId) (L172-L177) implies params.prizeToken is a standards-compliant, non-adversarial ERC-721 contract throughout the raffle lifecycle.

IERC165(params.prizeToken).supportsInterface(type(IERC721).interfaceId) (L172) executes within bounded gas and return-data size without exhausting caller gas (no explicit gas stipend is set on the try call at L172).

params.sponsorRecipient (after passing address(0) and current protocol-destination checks at L156, L163-L169) is not a future RaffleFactory CREATE clone address that will later become true in isRaffle (which would cause Raffle._transferQuote at packages/contracts/src/Raffle.sol:L565, L603 to revert) and can accept quoteToken and prizeToken transfers without reverting.
params.reserveEntries (checked only for != 0 at L178) has a sensible upper bound below type(uint128).max.

calls.propagates: Reverts with NotContract(params.prizeToken) if params.prizeToken.code.length == 0 (packages/contracts/src/RaffleFactory.sol:L183-L185), establishing params.prizeToken.code.length > 0 and params.prizeToken != address(0) on the non-reverting path.

Executes a STATICCALL to untrusted params.prizeToken with selector 0x01ffc9a7 and interfaceId 0x80ac58cd (packages/contracts/src/RaffleFactory.sol:L172, packages/contracts/node_modules/@openzeppelin/contracts/utils/introspection/IERC165.sol:L24); establishes only that params.prizeToken did not revert and returned ABI-decodable true at validation time (L172-L177), without guaranteeing ERC-721 compliance.

invariants.claim: If _validateCreateParams returns normally, params.prizeToken has non-zero deployed bytecode length (and is therefore non-zero).
If _validateCreateParams returns normally, params.sponsorRecipient is not address(0).
If _validateCreateParams returns normally, params.prizeToken is not address(this), quoteToken, vrfWrapper, raffleImplementation, or any address currently registered in isRaffle.

If _validateCreateParams returns normally, params.sponsorRecipient is not address(this), quoteToken, vrfWrapper, params.prizeToken, raffleImplementation, or any address currently registered in isRaffle.
If _validateCreateParams returns normally, IERC165(params.prizeToken).supportsInterface(type(IERC721).interfaceId) succeeded via STATICCALL and returned true.
